images.name: 01 — Bevel Konsol
images.prompt: Create ONE finished 2048x2048 square 2K design-system button asset exploration sheet for KoBi — Komuniti Bijak, a Malaysian neighbourhood mobile web app. This sheet is a complete reusable button family covering map, reports, activities, profile, account and staff world editor, not a screenshot or phone mockup. Authentic 16-bit hand-pixelled game UI: coherent visible square pixel grid, crisp stepped silhouettes and corners, flat limited colour clusters, hard pixel highlights, no antialiasing or blurry edges, no smooth vector curves, no realistic 3D rendering, no gradients. Strict shared brand palette sampled from existing KoBi document: dark plum #5E3543 (outlines and text), lime #B6D53C (primary action), rose #CC6092 (secondary/accent), warm cream #FFF4E7, blush #FBE1E5, pale sage #EAF0D8, muted text #6B5C62, terracotta #A05C53 (destructive). Use only these colours, with no new blue/cyan/neon/yellow. Layout on a uniform flat warm cream #FFF4E7 background, generous isolated gutters around every component so assets can later be cropped; no checkerboard and no claim of transparent background. Front-facing orthographic flat UI, aligned organised sprite-sheet presentation. Clear Malay labels only. Short title at top, small eight-colour swatch strip with legible hex labels below it. Four concise sections: 'UTAMA' for large CTA buttons, 'SAIZ & BENTUK' for different sizes and icon buttons, 'KEADAAN' for the same button default/pressed/focused/disabled/pending, and 'NAVIGASI' for tabs and chips. Include precisely these useful examples: a wide lime 'Hantar Aduan', wide plum 'Log Masuk', medium rose 'Sertai Aktiviti', medium outlined 'Lihat di Peta', medium neutral 'Batal', compact 'Simpan', compact 'Sunting', terracotta 'Buang' with bin icon, icon-only square plus, minus, back arrow, close X, camera, settings. Include blank unlabelled counterparts of a large, medium and small button for reusable skins with live text later. Show 3 clearly different widths but usable mobile proportions: design for runtime small 80x44, medium 160x48, wide 328x56 CSS px; icon touch target 44x44. Show same 'Simpan' state family labelled 'Biasa', 'Ditekan', 'Fokus', 'Tidak Aktif', 'Memproses'; visibly depressed pressed state, high-contrast pixel focus outline, subdued disabled state, tiny pixel progress indicator. Bottom navigation labelled 'Peta', 'Aduan', 'Aktiviti', 'Profil' with matching simple pixel icons and Peta selected, plus small chips 'Semua', 'Komuniti', 'Kitar Semula'. Readable Malay labels in a clean simple sans-serif with a restrained game feel; decorative pixel lettering only in sheet title. Keep all components large enough to inspect; clean premium craft, no extraneous artwork, no game economy, no coins, no shop, no mascot, no watermarks, no photographic textures. Approach 1: CLASSIC 16-BIT CONSOLE BEVEL. Chunky rectangular buttons with 2-step cut corners, a precise light upper-left bevel, dark plum 2-pixel outline, substantial 4-pixel lower-right hard extrusion, inset pixel inner keyline. Lime tops with pale sage highlights. Tactile familiar SNES-era interface interpreted for a calm civic app. Solid substantial hardware-like silhouette, geometric and disciplined. Title 'KoBi / 01 BEVEL KONSOL'.
